mcpapi 0 snapshot -h
stderr 'Usage of snapshot'

# The declared enum narrows, unsupported patterns are unknown, and identical supported snapshots pass.
mcpapi 0 diff old.json old.json
stdout '^\[\]'
mcpapi 1 diff old.json narrow.json
stdout 'incompatible'
mcpapi 2 diff old.json unknown.json
stdout 'unknown'
mcpapi 3 diff missing.json old.json
stderr 'mcpapi:'
mcpapi 3 snapshot -- server
stderr 'visibility labels'
